Reborn into the young noble body of Julian Vaelgard, a frail noble heir assassinated by the celestial God-Weeping Root poison. characters.description: The legendary soul-bound weapon of Aiden Drake, the First Sword Saint. Forged from primordial obsidian volcanic glass capable of severing mana threads, magic domains, and divine law. Following Aiden's fall at the Celestial Altar 1,000 years ago, the blade was recovered and enshrined in the deepest ancestral treasury vault of House Vaelgard, slumbering in dormant stasis until its true master Julian reclaims it.
